subject: ClientCo: request for fix verification and compensating controls
messages:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@clientco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, security@clientco.com
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Verification of remediation for penetration findings

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. ClientCo finished an internal review of the pen test report and we have follow-up questions before we can clear the findings for our compliance audit. Specifically we need concrete evidence that the fixes you described are in place and effective. Can you provide: 

- Screenshots of the updated firewall/WAF rules and the applied ACL entries (redacted as needed)
- Configuration export for the affected service (sanitized, with any customer data removed)
- Links to the ticket(s) or changelog entries where the fixes were completed (Jira or similar)
- A short note on compensating controls for the race-condition issue (what monitoring/alerting is in place)

We understand some artifacts may be sensitive; a redacted package or attestations from your security team are fine. We need this by EOD Monday (2026-01-12) to stay on our audit timeline.

Appreciate your help — please loop in whoever owns the configs.

Best,
Alice
Alice Jones
Security Engineer, ClientCo
security@clientco.com

---
(Original pen test reference: ClientCo PT report v1.2, findings IDs 12, 17, 23)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@clientco.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Verification of remediation for penetration findings

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. I'm assembling a validation package for you. Plan: 

1) I'll pull screenshots and a sanitized config export for the affected endpoint and WAF rules (we'll remove any customer-identifying lines).
2) I'll include direct links to the Jira tickets where the work was tracked and the CI/CD deploys that shipped the fixes.
3) Mina will draft a short compensating-controls write-up about monitoring/alerting and any rate-limiting mitigations.
4) We'll redact any sensitive log snippets and include a CSV of hash digests for integrity.

I expect an initial package tomorrow (2026-01-09) and a final, signed PDF by EOD 2026-01-10. If you need things earlier or in a specific format (PDF vs ZIP), let me know.

--
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

Attachment: fix-validation-plan.pdf (one-line summary of what we'll include)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: collect ClientCo evidence pack (urgent)

Team — Alice at ClientCo needs a verification pack for pen test findings (see thread). Deliverables: 

- Markus: export current WAF rule set and provide 3 annotated screenshots (UI + rule diff). Save as screenshots-config-20260109.zip. Remove any hostnames that reference customers.
- Monica: pull the config export for the service (yaml) and sanitize secrets; include a short note on the deploy that fixed findings (include exact commit hash and timestamp). Put in jira-RED-7891-export.txt and reference RED-7891.
- Mina: write a 1-page compensating-controls note detailing: alerting thresholds, playbooks triggered, MFA/session-enforcement changes, and the short-term rate-limit implemented after the finding. Sign and timestamp.

We must provide traceable ticket IDs and at least one evidence of deploy (CI/CD job link or build id). Client asked for redacted artifacts and a final PDF. I'll assemble and produce fix-validation-pack.pdf by EOD 2026-01-10.

Thanks — Diego

---
On Thu, Jan 8, 2026, at 11:03 AM, Diego Fernandez wrote:
> Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@clientco.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: ClientCo: fix verification pack and compensating controls (attached)

Hi Alice — attaching the verification package we discussed. Summary below and attachments are included. If you need additional detail or a live walkthrough of any item, we can schedule a 30-minute screenshare.

Summary of what's included:
- screenshots-config-20260109.zip: three annotated screenshots showing WAF rule deployment and the ACL diff (redacted).
- jira-RED-7891-export.txt: export of the Jira ticket thread and the changelog entries (ticket RED-7891 tracked the remediation).
- fix-validation-pack.pdf: single PDF with an executive summary, list of artifacts, and attestation from our security team.
- Compensating controls (in PDF): MFA is enforced for all RBAC access to the deploy pipeline; session timeouts reduced to 15 minutes for admin roles; additional WAF signature created (ID waf-rule-4321). Alerting: we have a Prometheus alert and PagerDuty playbook tuned to the specific anomaly that would indicate recurrence (playbook ID PD-125).

Key references and evidence links:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-7891
- CI/CD build: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/54821 (deploy timestamp: 2026-01-05T02:14:33Z)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cFixValidationPack

Notes on redaction: all artifacts have hostnames and customer identifiers replaced with placeholders. Where logs could contain PII we included only hash digests and timestamps.

Attachments: fix-validation-pack.pdf; screenshots-config-20260109.zip; jira-RED-7891-export.txt

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let me know if this satisfies the audit requirements or if the ClientCo security team wants a short demo. We can also provide an SOC 2 auditor-facing checksum manifest if needed.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Email: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
